audit_items.proof_trace: Blobs from Engine API bypass KZG verification: from_execution_verified() wraps blobs without calling validate_blob(). Gossip blobs use KzgVerifiedBlob::new() which performs verification, but Engine API path skips this check before propagation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Compromised EL sends invalid blob with mismatched KZG proof. Beacon node publishes unverified blob to P2P network. Honest peers reject the blob and may penalize the propagating node.
